notes.title: Galaxis Wars Opening Week Key Giveaway!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to announce that Galaxis Wars is coming soon to Steam! With our launch next week, we are giving away 5 FREE Keys for Galaxis Wars. To check out our giveaway, and learn more about the game, head over to http://www.clearinkstudios.com/giveaways. We will be announcing winners around our release time at 12 Noon (EST) on May 30th. Come check us out, and good luck on your adventures to defeat the Galaxis!

- Grant
